Investigate MOUSE: P.I. For Hire today on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mouse-p-i-for-hire-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Detectives, there's a new case for you! MOUSE: P.I. For Hire is a new action-packed FPS with black and white rubber hose animation. What looks to be a simple missing persons case quickly escalates into a thrilling noir detective story as you explore the seedy underbelly of Mouseburg, delving deeper into a web of corruption, murder, and lies.
